reviews.t: Excited to be a Sanderson Sister on Halloween!
reviews.x: I am SO excited to wear this costume (Color: Reddish Brown) and become Winifred Sanderson - the red-headed witch in Hocus Pocus! The wig came in three pieces: the main part which you wear on your head and two little buns that have hidden hair claws on the underside to attach to the main wig. There's a black netted wig cap that you need to put on your head before wearing the main wig. There's a necklace and a pair of earrings to go with it (not sure if they really matched her character in the mov
I love the color and the curls. I like how it fits!

reviews.t: Fun and pretty realistic looking wig
reviews.x: This wig was great for the money.  I believe it's a Carol Baskin style wig, but I bought it to be a Celtic queen. It was bent at the bottom from being folded in the package, so I wet it and even used a straightener to try and "unbend" it.  It mostly worked. I ended up trimming all of the bottom to make it look less scraggly (although in the full-length picture, it still looks that way. 😄) Anyway, the wig was fine for my costume.
The wig is great because the side portions that look like buns are actually detachable so you can custom it. The teeth even came with glue to secure them! Nice set, would definitely buy again.
it is perfect for Halloween. The wig ahas a clip inside that way it doesn’t slide off of your head. It comes with accessories too. It also comes with a net to put into your head before.
I couldn’t get teeth to stick so I didn’t use them but the wig was comfortable and looked great. Jewelry looked the part. Was worth every penny even though I didn’t use the teeth
Going to have to fluff the wig a little, but it's good quality. The jewelry and teeth are also perfect. Can't wait for the party. Will be wearing this every year. :D

reviews.t: Great Wig, came with everything you need!
reviews.x: I had such fun dressing up as Winifred Sanderson! This wig was the piece de resistance! It came with everything you need plus extras like the prosthetic teeth (with adhesive) and jewelry that added nice Finnish in touches.  The wig came with a hair net that easily grabbed your hair making it easy to put the wig on,  the wig was adjustable and easy to wear.  The additional buns had comb clips making them easy to add to wig. I wore it all day and very thing stayed put.  Loved the color.  I was ver

The wig is super easy to style and comfortable to wear.  The jewelry was perfect for my costume too.  The only issue I had were the teeth and it wasn't necessarily the product, it was the application time.  The adhesive takes 10-15 minutes to set, and you can't talk, eat, drink, etc, while they set.  As a mama to 2 small littles and no other adults around to help, not speaking for 10 to 15 minutes wasn't feasible, so I only posed with the teeth for photos.  I am very happy with the kit overall,

The teeth didn't work out for me, but I think it's because I have tiny teeth 😅... but the wig was WAY nicer than I anticipated. Even a friend of mine who does princess dress ups as a job was impressed with the quality for how much I spent. The jewelry tied it all together. I got lots of compliments on my winnifred ensemble and we (group dressed as the sisters) were asked a couple times to stop and pose for pictures 😅. There were only like 6 kids who were convinced we were out to get them 🤣

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wig's realistic appearance and quality.
Many reviewers highlight the included accessories (jewelry, teeth, braids) as a valuable bonus.
The wig is commonly described as comfortable and well-fitting, with clips to keep it secure.
Reviewers often note it is good value for the price.
A few reviewers mention needing to adjust or fluff the wig, and one couldn't get the teeth to stick.
